deploy-bot: 🚀 Staging deploy started
deploy-bot: env=staging, tag=v2-8-1, commit=`ab12cd34ef56`, initiated_by=@alana, changelist=https://git.redwood.internal/release/v2-8-1
alana: on it — starting smoke watch, will monitor error rates & tail logs for the next 15m :eyes:
mike: watching infra metrics (GPU mem, queue length). ping me if latency > 350ms
jamie: quick heads-up — I'm seeing a small spike of 502s from reranker-sidecar on two hosts, digging into logs now
sre-oncall: joining — grabbing traces from jaeger, will check if it's a routing flakiness or a code regression
deploy-bot: canary rollout at 25% complete, healthchecks OK for 3/4 pods, one pod showing intermittent 502s
devops-lead: hold traffic shift at 25% until we understand the 502s. we shouldn't advance with transient 5xxs
alana: ack, pausing rollout. switching to pinned canary and gathering logs:
```
kubectl logs pod/reranker-canary-7f -n staging --since=10m
```
mike: I see increased connection timeouts to backend-ranker on those nodes, looks like ephemeral network loss — nothing in infra alerts yet
sre-oncall: traced requests — failures land on a single envoy config version. rolling that config back to previous (v3 -> v2) on affected hosts
jamie: after config rollback, 502s dropped to normal levels within 40s. can we resume?
devops-lead: resume but slow: advance to 50% and keep rollout probe interval at 30s
deploy-bot: resuming rollout: advancing to 50% (probe_interval=30s). will report next checkpoint
alana: smoke tests running: generation sanity, embeddings sanity, and a short eval set (10 prompts) — all green so far :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: checkpoint: 50% -> 100% in progress. final healthchecks passing on all hosts
deploy-bot: ✅ Staging deploy completed — tag=v2-8-1, commit=`ab12cd34ef56`. duration=18m12s. rollout notes: https://deploys.redwood.internal/notes/v2-8-1
mike: nice work. suggest we pin this tag for the next QA cycle and create a small perf watch for 24h
alana: noted, pinning to staging as requested. will open a follow-up thread for QA/benchmarks
devops-lead: creating a quick post-deploy checklist item: monitor reranker error budget and tail latency for 24h, alert if sustained >1% errors or p95 > 400ms
sre-oncall: will keep an eye on traces and alerts — will escalate if anything looks off
jamie: thanks everyone, closing watch. :tada:
(automated) deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot — summary: completed, no rollback required, pinned to staging, follow-up: QA bench + 24h perf watch.
